## What is AI for entrepreneurs?

AI for entrepreneurs is using artificial intelligence advancements to start a business faster and more cost-effectively.

Instead of spending months developing an app and finding customers, entrepreneurs use predictive and generative AI tools to speed up tasks like coding and testing. AI also supports customer acquisition by performing tasks like sending personalized sales emails with a one-sentence prompt.

For example, here’s an email created using Pipedrive’s AI email writer:

Entrepreneurs also use AI to: [...] |  |  |

| Automate with AI | Leave to humans |
| Content creation. Create engaging copy using ChatGPT or another dedicated copywriting tool. | Proofreading. AI’s tendency to hallucinate means entrepreneurs should check every output. |
| Customer support. Automate simple customer support requests using conversational AI. | Customer success. Onboarding requires a hands-on approach and a nuanced understanding of customer requirements. |
| Recruitment. Use AI to analyze job applications and identify top performers. | Interviewing. No software can replace the trust and transparency of human conversation. | [...] AI can generate a good foundational site because its machine-learning algorithms reference millions of websites before creating something new. Entrepreneurs get expert assistance at a fraction of the price.

AI removes budgetary pressures so entrepreneurs don’t have to choose between building a website and hiring more salespeople or developing a better marketing strategy. Business owners can invest their savings in other areas of their business.

### Launch faster by automating processes

AI automates a lot of the time-consuming administrative and creative work of building a business, like finding the right sales prospects and designing a website. The resulting time savings help entrepreneurs launch businesses faster without sacrificing work quality.
